change.purpose: Operator requests 2026-09-25: (a) recover from Chrome white screen / unresponsive tab and from a partially rendered ChatGPT UI (composer missing left SENDING held on THINKING_MODE_UNVERIFIED); (b) handle the inline ChatGPT content-block notice (Daybreak) by rotating the same GFW, pausing it on repeats, never BLOCKED.

operatorDecisions.daybreak: first block -> rotate same GFW into a fresh chat; repeat within 24 h -> pause 2 h, then 6 h, then 24 h; chain resets after 24 h without a block; never BLOCKED

change.rootCause: content bridge calls (chrome.tabs.sendMessage) had no deadline; ticks are serialized per process and the watchdog queued behind a hung tick; every transition awaited broadcast -> syncOverlay to the same tab; the SENDING safety hold never escalated to a reload
change.deadlines: lib/tab-health.mjs TAB_HEALTH: bridge 15 s, overlay 5 s, inject 20 s, submit 90 s (unknown effect -> existing dispatch reconciliation), preflight 60 s
change.conditions: BRIDGE_UNRESPONSIVE, BRIDGE_MISSING, TAB_DISCARDED, RENDER_STALLED (visible >=45 s and requested frame not delivered >=45 s), COMPOSER_MISSING (SENDING), THREAD_MISSING (conversation URL with 0 turns); Chrome-frozen tabs are waited out; managed tabs set autoDiscardable:false
change.ladder: REINJECT (bridge missing only) -> RELOAD -> HARD_RELOAD -> NAVIGATE_SAME_URL -> REPLACE_TAB (same conversation, same window, old tab closed, existing single-tab rebind) -> GIVE_UP (session rotation TAB_HEALTH_RECOVERY_EXHAUSTED); UI grace 90 s, 45 s between steps, budget 5 actions/hour/process, no UI step while a dispatch has unknown effect
change.tickRescue: watchdog does not enqueue behind a tick in flight > 3 min; reloads the tab at most every 5 min in WAITING/SENDING(no dispatch)/DETACHED/RECOVERING/ROTATING; audit TICK_STALL_RESCUE
change.providerNotice: content.js detectProviderNotice: 'Daybreak' + headline (en/sv) or cyber word (en/sv/fi), outside every message turn, after the anchor user turn; acted on after two sightings >= 3 s apart and not while generating; the turn is not counted in the quantum; learning keypoints POST_FAILURE / RECURRING PROVIDER_CONTENT_BLOCK_REPEATED
change.pause: queue slot: schedule.pauseUntilMs = max(existing, now + pause), updatedBy GREENFIELD, status READY, parked PROVIDER_CONTENT_BLOCKED_PAUSED, queue continues (QUEUE_WAIT when none runnable); outside a queue: hold PROVIDER_CONTENT_BLOCK_PAUSE

boundaries.gpuOnlyWhiteScreen: a white screen where page script runs and frames are delivered is not detectable without captureVisibleTab (<all_urls>/activeTab not added)
boundaries.wholeBrowserFreeze: an extension cannot act when all of Chrome is frozen
boundaries.replaceTabRebind: rebind requires exactly one ChatGPT tab in the worker window; otherwise session rotation after 6 attempts as before
boundaries.navigateSameUrl: equivalence with pasting the URL in the address bar is not proven
boundaries.finnishHeadline: unknown; detection relies on 'Daybreak' + cyber word
boundaries.e2eScope: real background.js ticks with harness timers (deadlines fired explicitly), real content.js in Chromium for detection only
